about.title: The hands behind Kimil Fabrics
about.body1: Kimil Fabrics is a made-to-measure atelier founded on a simple belief: clothing should fit the person, not the other way around. Every gown, suit and shirt that leaves the studio is cut, stitched and finished by hand.
about.body2: Based in Canada and serving clients for her and for him, the atelier blends classic tailoring techniques with a modern eye for fit, fabric and finish — made to last, and worn with confidence.
about.value1Desc: Every measurement is taken with care so the finished piece feels like it was made for you — because it was.
about.value2Desc: Quality materials chosen for how they wear, move and last, not just how they photograph.
about.value3Desc: Reinforced seams and thoughtful construction, so your piece stays with you for years.
